purpose: Define one authoritative building assembly model consumed by editor, PCG and runtime while preserving exact PublishedWorldAsset component identity and same-world multi-level interiors.

requiredLevelSemantics.connectors: explicit BuildingLevelConnector records; never implicit scene transitions

separateSceneExceptions: deep cave or mine network after an explicit connector boundary
special content with a genuine streaming or instancing requirement
forbiddenPatterns: one scene per ordinary house interior
one scene per ordinary upstairs floor
one scene per ordinary cellar or basement
ObjectKind used as building visual identity
wrong-facing wall sprite substituted for an unresolved facing
generated atlas coordinates treated as semantic identity
camera cutaway changing collision, simulation, persistence, or multiplayer state
